scope: Read-only code review and review of 11 passing pre-profile tests; no new policy execution or evaluation outcome used.

checks.actor_observation_isolation: profile_model receives acquired mapper and neutral B6 AB model only; no source geometry, hidden extent, future branch mesh or evaluation metric read by profile.py.
checks.common_ray_basis: Rays selected once per object from finite positive acquired depth pixels, stride 3, maximum-search envelope, with exact pose/K/pixel/depth deduplication; same fixed denominator for every depth and both hypotheses.
checks.roi_parts: ROI includes every absolute slab height, including layers beyond box/leg height; width, yaw and measured depth anchor fixed.
checks.camera_depth_units: World ray direction is rotation applied to camera [x,y,1]; cast parameter t remains camera-z metres, consistent with frame.depth_m.
checks.historical_veto: Inherited B2 hash-pinned classify_history applied to predicted front hits; measured surface in any acquired frame vetoes strict-free classification. Closer actual hits are occlusion, not free evidence.
checks.B6_primitive_equivalence: Construction uses world center transformed into rotation-local coordinates, then rotates at origin, equivalent to frozen B6 centered construction; layer intervals, posts and bit-derived backboard orientation preserved. Pre-profile test checks mesh distances and sample-to-surface parity.
checks.neutral_geometry: Equal .5/.5 structural mixture and common acquired support; no S category prior or reward weight enters the profile.
checks.declared_estimator_condition: Selection requires exclusion of prior from connected min+1 band with finite internal upper crossing plus improvement of measured-free discrepancy in at least one structural hypothesis; explicitly recorded in METHOD_SPEC and tested. It is a depth-estimator condition, not a navigation-candidate filter.
checks.uncertainty: Heuristic grid band explicitly not a confidence interval; no-anchor/two-anchor/degenerate support retains dimensions; prior-in-band and artificial upper-bound cases retain dimensions; measured lower boundary may yield finite upper constraint.
checks.runner_parity: Runner checks exact frozen B6 G/S points, weights and hypothesis IDs, original prefix receipt/routes/native TSDF bytes, fit-support hashes, frame fingerprints, all acquired mapper arrays and both model/object audit snapshots before/after.
checks.no_new_branch: Runner does not score candidates or acquire branches; root/model remain unchanged. No 66-branch reevaluation is needed if all diagnostic dimensions are retained.

limitations: The fixed camera-z residual and Euclidean surface residual share metre units but represent heuristic discrepancies, not calibrated independent sensor likelihoods.
Valid rays with earlier real occluders remain in the fixed denominator with zero free penalty; this avoids hypothesis-dependent sampling but may dilute evidence.
The 1e-12 free-improvement comparison tests existence rather than effect size; prior exclusion by the predeclared neutral profile band remains the main finite-evidence condition.
Only exactly one anchored local-depth endpoint is profiled. Missing anchors, orientation errors, width errors and unsupported layer/post hypotheses remain unresolved.
Six reused development prefixes are dependent diagnostic evidence, not independent policy trials or real-world accuracy validation.
pre_freeze_requirement: Final protocol must replace draft status and pending profile-design placeholder with fixed method specification; runner may add this receipt to freeze list without changing execution logic.
post_profile_review: Inspect all objects and curves, immutable support/ray fingerprints, grid extrema, prior exclusion and retained/adopted reasons before any separately frozen parameter-update study. No post-result threshold tuning.
